description: This file contains implementations of functions related to inverting or undoing view operations on tensors within the PyTorch framework, particularly for functionalization passes. It defines various inverse functions for tensor views and mutations, facilitating operations like permutes, unsqueezes, slices, transposes, and others. It is part of the 'at::functionalization' namespace, focusing on functionalization logic for tensor manipulations.
